coefficient_grouping: Bare hooks share one native result across Laurent tags through four FIFO entries; each tag consumed once; bitwise inputs including signed zeros
notes: Timed routes execute sequentially after this audit's builds and numerical tests stop; other users' work is not stopped.
Prepared backend initialization and outer compilation are excluded from warmed timings and logged separately.
Rust and Fortran include a finite-coefficient checksum in timing; Python checks every timed coefficient and checksum outside timing.
Python includes input conversion and result-object allocation, but excludes prepared input lists and final output destruction.
Four full 1024-row batches and a one-row tail are timed in every 1024-row repetition.
Native Float and DoubleFloat support is not measured by this binary64 survey.
The 1.5x target is per workload, not an aggregate mean or a universal-domain guarantee.
